points.text: Using region as the partition key groups all feeds into a few massive partitions. Partitioning by user identifier allows direct lookups and spreads feed data evenly across storage nodes.
points.quote: table kv.feeds(region pk, user_id, posts, updated_at) index(user_id)

Using the creation timestamp as the primary key will cause writes to fail whenever multiple links are generated at the exact same time. The generated short code or an auto-incrementing identifier should be the primary key.
